# Built-in terminology glossary (extend — do not edit in place)

Format: markdown table, one concept per row. The engine parses every `|`-row with ≥2
cells: first cell = canonical term, remaining cells = synonyms / abbreviations /
Chinese-English equivalents (comma, semicolon or slash separated). To add case-specific
terms, write your own table to `/app/work/glossary_extra.md` in the same format; the
engine merges it automatically. This file is a generic seed for common scientific
vocabulary.
